verdict.rationale: Supabase's own docs say self-hosted Supabase does not phone home or collect any telemetry, so running it yourself avoids usage tracking. However, this comes from choosing the self-hosted deployment, not from an opt-out control. Nothing in the evidence describes opting out of telemetry on the hosted platform or for Auth specifically. Missing for 10: a documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out setting for hosted Supabase Auth, Auth-specific privacy controls, and independent corroboration of the no-telemetry claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Self-hosted Supabase **does not phone home or collect any telemetry**.
Install and run your own Supabase on your computer, server, or cloud infrastructure.
